anytime.title: Ossa's Heart comes back from the Seam
anytime.why: The Heron wrecked, or a voyage was made.
anytime.readAloud: A ferryman hauls a net aboard and goes very quiet.
anytime.response: The safety valve: the Heron wrecks in the Stormwall and the Mere returns the Heart weeks later; or the party voyages to Athkatla (six weeks). Either way it is recovered.
anytime.consequence: The party holds Ossa's Heart.
anytime.tells: The Heart is gone abroad.
anytime.later: Ossa is one of the six.
anytime.keywords: ossa, abroad, lost, wreck

anytime.title: Ansel Quay finds Calla's Heart
anytime.why: The Court moved it, and Ansel knows where.
anytime.readAloud: Ansel taps a column of the ledger. “Moved to the Almoner's cellar. I did not move it. I can find it.”
anytime.response: Ansel can fetch the Heart for a favor. No roll; it takes three days.
anytime.consequence: The party holds Calla's Heart.
anytime.tells: Ansel is an ally.
anytime.later: Calla is one of the six.
anytime.keywords: ansel, calla, court, moved

anytime.title: Ansel Quay finds Vaer's Heart
anytime.why: The Court took it.
anytime.readAloud: Ansel unfolds a map. “The armory. Third door.”
anytime.response: Ansel can fetch it for a favor.
anytime.consequence: The party holds Vaer's Heart.
anytime.tells: Ansel is an ally.
anytime.later: Vaer is one of the six.
anytime.keywords: ansel, vaer, court

anytime.title: They take the Frost Heart from the Sexton's crown
anytime.why: The Sexton was freed or ended.
anytime.readAloud: The Heart lies in the broken crown, cold as ice.
anytime.response: The Heart falls from the crown when the Sexton's shell breaks. The party takes it.
anytime.consequence: The party holds the Frost Heart.
anytime.tells: The Sexton's winter-moment is over.
anytime.later: Hieme is one of the six.
anytime.keywords: frost heart, hieme, sexton

anytime.title: They sell a storm-stone in Pellmoor
anytime.why: Mirabar dwarves pay well.
anytime.readAloud: The dwarf turns the stone in his fingers. “Illegal. Beautiful. Eight hundred.”
anytime.response: A stone sells for 800 gp. The Court arrests sellers; the Coster notices. The Landing clock ticks.
anytime.consequence: Money, and the Court's eye.
anytime.tells: A player asks what a stone is worth.
anytime.later: S28: the Landing.
anytime.keywords: storm-stone, sell, pellmoor

anytime.title: Wren's route brings out Calla's Heart
anytime.why: Wren Caddock knows a Bellwright way out of the city.
anytime.readAloud: Wren slides a key across the table. “It's in a bell-cart, if you are quick.”
anytime.response: The Bellwright route brings out the Heart. Wren is in danger if the Court notices.
anytime.consequence: The party holds Calla's Heart.
anytime.tells: Wren is an ally.
anytime.later: Calla is one of the six.
anytime.keywords: wren, calla, route, bellwright

anytime.title: They take the Key back from the Court or Tristan
anytime.why: Losing the Key in a fight is never the end: only the players choose the Empty Choir. A table that still resists will go after it.
anytime.readAloud: The Key travels in a silence-stone case on a Court wagon, four Wardens around it and a clerk who counts the hours aloud.
anytime.response: Tell them where it is: on its way back to Maudrin’s palace vault in Hallowmere, or to Tristan if Maudrin is gone. Give them one of three ways in: the road convoy (an ambush on the North Road, two Hushman Wardens and a Sergeant), Ansel Quay’s vault schedule, or a bargain with whoever now commands the Court. Allies they gathered for S22 can take one objective each. Whatever they choose, the Key reaches the party if they succeed; if they fail, they escape to try again. This is an escape-or-rescue chapter, not an ending.
anytime.consequence: The Key is back with the party; the Court knows exactly who took it.
anytime.fallback: If the table wants to stop instead, that is the Empty Choir: ask them, out of character, before you set it.
anytime.tells: The party was beaten, captured or outrun at the Strike, the summit or the stairs, and asks where the Key went.
anytime.rules: Stealth or Sleight of Hand DC 16 for the case; Influence DC 18 with Tristan or Maudrin (Intelligence 18).
anytime.later: S26: with the Key, every ending except the Empty Choir is open again.
anytime.keywords: take the key back, recover the key, steal the key, convoy, rescue, court has the key, lost the key

encounters.title: Quill's patrol
encounters.tactics: Two Hushmen hold the doorway with Pack Tactics while two flank through the net-racks and Quill backs toward witnesses. They target whoever holds the Heart and use Arrest, not killing blows.
encounters.exit: Quill retreats toward the Landing House when his guard is Bloodied or a ferry-folk crowd gathers. He wants an arrest, never a death; a downed PC is bound, not killed.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters. Three PCs: drop two Hushmen. Five PCs or a party that opens with area spells or Hold Person on Quill: add a Hushman Sergeant who arrives in round two. The Landing House post (six Hushmen) comes only if the party chases Quill onto the Quays; telegraph boots on the boards a round early.

encounters.title: The night raid on the Harrow house
encounters.tactics: They search for the Heart first and fight only if blocked. The sergeant watches the door and uses Command; two search; one waits by the boat.
encounters.exit: They withdraw when one drops or the Old Shore wakes (two rounds of noise). They never pursue onto the water.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters. Three PCs: no sergeant. Five PCs: add Quill outside, who flees at the first blow.

encounters.title: Memory-eels at the sandbank
encounters.tactics: They strike from below at anyone wading or swimming, and try to drag one character under. They ignore people sitting in boats for the first round.
encounters.exit: They flee when reduced to two, or when the dead ferryman's oar is raised. Sneaking past (DC 15 Stealth, half the group) avoids the fight.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters. The eels are the bait; the cold water and the drag-under are the pressure. Three PCs: four eels. Five PCs: eight. Don't chain this straight into the Drowned Singers: give a short rest on the sandbank.

encounters.title: Drowned Singers at the belfry
encounters.tactics: One Singer wails to frighten swimmers; the other grapples and pulls a diver down while the eels harry anyone left at the surface. The Cantor sings but does not join.
encounters.exit: It stops pursuit at the surface and treats Mother Sallow's response hymn as a ceasefire. Divers can always swim up.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters, but underwater: breath is the real clock, so it plays harder than its XP. Three PCs: one Singer. Five PCs: add a third Singer. Show their approach a round early. Paralysis stays removed from the Singer: a Paralyzed diver would drown.

encounters.title: The ferry-stair guard
encounters.tactics: Guards the ferry-stair against anyone the Choir marked as forgetful, or anyone who comes without the hymn or the Tidewarden.
encounters.exit: Singing the response hymn, returning the Heart, or the Tidewarden's company ends it at once.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters (Moderate in practice on the stair, where only two can stand abreast). Brother Hadrik's forced blessing adds a fourth Singer. Three PCs: two Singers.

encounters.title: Boarding the Gilded Heron
encounters.tactics: The guards use Pack Tactics on deck; the mate, a Zhentarim hand Venn pays not to ask questions, goes for whoever holds the Heart. The Baldurian crew stay out of it. Venn stays behind them and talks.
encounters.exit: Venn negotiates the moment a guard is Bloodied: the Heart for safe passage off his ship and no complaint to the Court.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters. Add two guards if the party arrives with Hold Person and Invisibility ready. If the party sneaks aboard (DC 15 Stealth each), only one guard and the mate are on watch.

encounters.title: The Mere road cart
encounters.tactics: They keep the cart between themselves and the party, grapple anyone who reaches the tailboard, and shout for the next checkpoint. They do not drive the cart on while it is under attack.
encounters.exit: The Sergeant yields the cart when two Hushmen drop or the ferry-folk driver unhitches. A downed PC is bound and left at the ford.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-3 characters (Low). Three PCs: drop one Hushman. Five PCs: add a Hushman. Ila stays in the cart.

encounters.title: Gate Hushmen
encounters.tactics: Cole shouts for the gate to close; his Hushmen grapple runners with Pack Tactics and drag them toward the Belfry. Treat Cole's pistol as a hand crossbow he fires at legs, not heads.
encounters.exit: Anyone who gets 60 feet into the lamp-lit lanes is lost in the fog; the Hushmen won't chase past the Hall of Tithes. A downed character wakes in a Belfry cell, not dead.
encounters.scale: 650 XP: Low for four level-3 PCs. For five PCs or level 4, add two Hushmen. For three PCs, Cole and one Hushman.

encounters.title: Haldric's escort at the masque
encounters.tactics: Haldric asks twice, then fights to disarm with the flat of his blade while the guards grapple. He keeps himself between the party and the side door Maudrin used.
encounters.exit: Leaving ends it. When Haldric is Bloodied he calls for terms, and the guests' screams bring Isolde to broker them. Downed characters are carried to Vaer's Belfry.
encounters.scale: 800 XP: between Low and Moderate at level 3. At level 4, add one Dawn Order Knight (Knight, CR 3) for Moderate. For three PCs, drop two guards.

encounters.title: Siege patrol on the Old Shore
encounters.tactics: They search house by house with torches, two at the door and two in the lane. They want the Heart and arrests; the Sergeant carries the grey-wax orders.
encounters.exit: Quill withdraws when two Hushmen drop or ferry-folk bar the lane. The Sergeant surrenders the orders rather than die. Retreat across the Mere with Brannagh's pilots ends pursuit.
encounters.scale: 850 XP: Moderate for four level-3 PCs. For level 4, add two Hushmen. For three PCs, remove the Sergeant.

encounters.title: Hushmen Line (vault alarm)
encounters.tactics: Two Hushmen reach the vault door in round 3, two more and the Sergeant in round 4. They block the doors and grapple rather than swing among the jars. Tonework fails in the vault, so casters inside fight with steel or not at all.
encounters.exit: The service passage is the way out; the Hushmen won't follow past the kitchens. Surrender means a cell, not a Tithe. They never break jars to stop a thief.
encounters.scale: 850 XP: Moderate for four level-3 PCs. For an escape-only scene, remove the Sergeant (400). At level 4, add two Hushmen. For three PCs, three Hushmen and no Sergeant.

encounters.title: The Librarian of the Sealed Book

creatures.name: The Librarian of the Sealed Book

encounters.tactics: The book does not move. Pages cut like blades (use the Knight's Greatsword, radiant damage as written light) and it uses Parry against hands reaching for the Heart. It targets only whoever is holding or grabbing.
encounters.exit: It stops the moment no one is touching the Heart or the book. It never pursues past the Stacks' door. Closing the book (DC 15 Strength, as an action) ends the fight and its answers for the day.
encounters.scale: 700 XP: Low-to-Moderate at level 3, Low at level 4. Don't add creatures; the keepers' Hushmen arrive in ten minutes if the party lingers.

encounters.title: Tessa's guards
encounters.tactics: One blocks the door while the other runs for the alarm bell at the stair-head. They grapple and shout; they do not hurt a child.
encounters.exit: Stop the runner within two rounds and there is no alarm. Once the bell rings, a Hushman Sergeant and two more Hushmen arrive in three rounds and the party should already be in the lanes; pursuit ends at Bet's bakery door, which the Hushmen never search.
encounters.scale: 200 XP: well under Low for level 3–4, on purpose; this is a stealth scene. If the alarm sounds, add the Sergeant and two Hushmen (850 total, Moderate at level 3).

encounters.title: Dawn Steps brawl
encounters.tactics: The knights flank and fight to disarm and arrest, using Parry. Haldric hangs back behind his shield and calls out to the crowd. Rook interposes on round 2 and will not fight her own knights.
encounters.exit: Standing down ends it at once; Haldric accepts surrender in front of the crowd because it makes him look merciful. Anyone dropped wakes in the Belfry cells. Rook's word gets them out after a day.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-4 characters. For a harder brawl add a second knight. For three PCs, Haldric alone. Don't scale beyond that: the Steps are crowded and the knights fight to disarm.

encounters.title: Hushmen Line at the Hall of Tithes
encounters.tactics: Six Hushmen shoulder to shoulder, using Pack Tactics and grappling anyone who interferes, passing prisoners back to the carts. Gaunt stays behind the line and fires her hand crossbow (the base's Pistol) only at someone casting.
encounters.exit: Gaunt withdraws when half her line is down, when the party holds the Hall's doors, or when the crowd sits down. Surrender means a night in the cells. Blanks in any area effect take the damage, so the party has reason to end it fast.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-4 characters. For a lighter scene use Gaunt and six Hushmen. For three PCs, Gaunt and six. Blanks in any area effect take the damage, so the party has reason to end it fast.

encounters.title: Courier snatch
encounters.tactics: Two Hushmen grab Edrin while the third blocks the alley; the agent goes for the letter and uses Cunning Action to Disengage and run with it.
encounters.exit: Once the party intervenes hard, the Hushmen let go of Edrin and fall back; the agent drops the letter if Bloodied. Nobody here wants a death in the street.
encounters.scale: 750 XP: under Low for four level-4 PCs; it is a scuffle. Add a Hushman Sergeant (1200, Low) for a real fight. For three PCs, the agent and two Hushmen.

encounters.title: Chain-room knights
encounters.tactics: They hold the stair at the top of the Belfry, one at the doorway and one with a crossbow behind. They shout for the watch. They are honest men doing their duty, and fight to disarm.
encounters.exit: If Rook won the duel, her writ makes them stand aside (Influence DC 15 without it). They surrender when Bloodied. Once Vaer rings they stop fighting to stare at the sun, and nobody pursues across the terraces that day.
encounters.scale: 1400 XP: Moderate for four level-4 PCs, below Low at level 5. At level 5, add a third knight (2100, Low). For three PCs, one knight.

encounters.title: Gate sweep at the north gate
encounters.tactics: Two Hushmen grapple whoever carries the Heart, two close the gate, one runs for the alarm bell. The Sergeant targets anyone matching a Warrant description.
encounters.exit: Hold the gate three rounds and the cart gets through; beyond the first mile the Hushmen turn back. Surrender means the cells, not a Tithe. A Sergeant named on Ilam's roster will take gold to look away mid-fight.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-4 characters. At level 5, add a second Sergeant and three Hushmen. If the Ringer carries a Warrant and Haldric won the duel, add two Dawn Order Knights instead. For three PCs, the Sergeant and three Hushmen.

encounters.title: Off the path: Glass-Wolves
encounters.tactics: The wolves circle, knock targets Prone, and use Pack Tactics on whoever is isolated. Each wolf that shatters cracks the nearest winter-moment; the two Stilled wake in rounds 2 and 3 and attack whoever is closest.
encounters.exit: The wolves flee from fire and from a high, steady note (Yara's whistle). Back on a marked path they stop. A woken Stilled can be talked down with Influence DC 15 as an action, in Hesk or old Common.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-5 characters. At level 6, add two wolves. For three PCs, three wolves and one Stilled.

encounters.title: Stilled Ambush
encounters.tactics: Two Stilled wake in round 1 and attack the nearest creature; one more each round as glass cracks, up to five. The wolves come out of the trees in round 2 and go for anyone Prone or alone. The Stilled are terrified, not cunning.
encounters.exit: Talking works: Influence DC 15 as an action calms one Stilled. Withdrawing 60 feet ends it, since the Stilled stand shaking where they woke. The wolves flee when half of them shatter.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-5 characters. Don't push it harder: the Stilled are victims. For three PCs, three Stilled and three wolves. Calming a Stilled removes it from the fight.

encounters.title: The Glass Sexton
encounters.tactics: Phase 1 (frost-form, 95 HP): he aims the Sermon (DC 15, Charmed with Speed 0) at the loudest arguer and Icicle Volley at whoever struck him last; he never leaves the pulpit. Fire or lightning damage lowers his AC by 2. When frost-form drops to 0 it shatters (DC 15 Dexterity, 15-foot Emanation) and Phase 2 begins at 45 HP: Glass Claw, Shattering Voice. One Stilled in the pews wakes in round 2 and cracks the glass behind the party.
encounters.exit: He stops at the end of any round in which nobody has attacked him, and asks whether they have finished. Melting his glass outside combat is the peaceful alternative: 20 Fire or Lightning damage to the ice, or a DC 15 Strength check, frees him gently. At 0 HP in broken-form the shell breaks, the Frost Heart falls from his crown, and the frail Imber survives unless someone kills him on purpose. Leaving the chapel ends the fight; he does not pursue.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-5 characters. For three PCs use 70 HP in frost-form and skip the Stilled. At level 6, a second Stilled wakes in round 2. The stat block's numbers are the rule; do not use older notes.

encounters.title: Spire guards
encounters.tactics: The wolves hold the base and drag anyone off the first rope. The Stilled on the ice stairs act only when glass breaks nearby or a climber passes within 5 feet, and strike to knock climbers off (DC 12 Strength save or fall 20 feet). Half the Stilled are dormant until the first wolf shatters.
encounters.exit: Climbers more than 60 feet up are out of the wolves' reach. The Stilled stop as soon as the bell rings. The wolves break off when three have shattered.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-6 characters. At level 5, remove two Stilled and one wolf. For three PCs, five wolves and three Stilled. The climb and the falls do more damage than the roster suggests.

encounters.title: Isolde's escort
encounters.tactics: Isolde talks first and fights only if attacked: one round of poisoned blades, then Cunning Action to Disengage and Dash. The Hushmen grapple to cover her withdrawal and fall back by twos.
encounters.exit: Isolde's retreat ends it once she is out of sight among the thawing trees. The Hushmen surrender if the Sergeant falls. Nobody pursues the party south.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-6 characters as a show of force, not a fair fight. If they fought their way out of Hallowmere (S9), add two Hushmen. For a night raid on her camp, add two more Sergeants. If Isolde is captured, Tristan Vesk comes with a smaller escort and no Cunning Action.

encounters.title: The storm-stone vault's guardians
encounters.tactics: One golem is awake at the door; each stone lifted wakes another, up to three. They attack whoever touches a stone and favour anyone in metal.
encounters.exit: Back out of the vault: they do not leave it. Prise a Bloodied golem's shard (DC 15 Strength (Athletics)) to switch it off, or carry Garrow's lamp past them: they recognise the storm-stone's kin and stand aside.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Two golems for a lighter fight; stones discharging each round (DC 13 Dexterity, 2d8 Lightning) as a hazard for a harder one.

encounters.title: The Sleepless at the stones
encounters.tactics: Each takes the shape of a sleeper's fear and goes for that sleeper; they gaze, then touch.
encounters.exit: They dissolve at dawn, if Mirel rings, or if the party retreats into the Hush Cult's circle.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Two Sleepless for a lighter fight; four for a harder one.

encounters.title: Kessa's champion and riders
encounters.tactics: Only if the party tries to take the Heart by force. The Champion challenges the strongest fighter to single combat; riders keep the others out and ride them down.
encounters.exit: Kessa stops it the moment someone proposes a fair wager instead.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Drop three riders and their horses for a duel plus an escort.

encounters.title: Kessa's duel
encounters.tactics: Kessa fights first and uses Thrane's Heart when Bloodied; the Champion watches the strongest fighter; the rider keeps the ring.
encounters.exit: First blood: when Kessa is Bloodied he may yield, and a fair yield ends it. Kessa honors his word.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Without the Champion it is a lighter duel; add a second rider for a harder one.

encounters.title: The Hush Cult defends the shrine
encounters.tactics: Cultists cast Command (Halt) and Sleep to take the front line out; the Leader drains dreams only from Charmed or Incapacitated targets. They never use "Rest" as a Command: 2024 Command allows only Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel and Halt.
encounters.exit: They stop if the party withdraws from the shrine, or if the Leader is convinced the rest is killing the Hush (Persuasion DC 16).
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Remove four cultists for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Bellwright ambush
encounters.tactics: The hounds bite and ring, making hiding impossible, and herd intruders toward the forge. Corin joins only if forced and stops the moment someone says they have rung a bell.
encounters.exit: Corin calls them off the moment anyone says they have rung a bell, or when he joins and is Bloodied.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Without Corin it is a lighter fight; three hounds with Corin is lighter still.

encounters.title: The Court's strike force on the Brass Road (Haldric's knights)
encounters.tactics: They demand the Heart, then try to seize whoever carries it; the Wardens' stones shut down casters.
encounters.exit: They withdraw if the Ironhorn ride in, or if their Wardens fall.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. If the Ironhorn are allies, give them an objective (hold the road, take the flank) rather than deleting creatures.

encounters.title: The Court's strike force on the Brass Road (Rook won)
encounters.tactics: Without knights, three Wardens expose their stones and Hushmen pin casters.
encounters.exit: They withdraw if the Ironhorn ride in, or if two Wardens fall.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Give any ally an objective rather than deleting creatures.

encounters.title: Court Hushmen reach the Tor
encounters.tactics: They arrest the Ringer and take the Heart; the Wardens expose their stones when casters act.
encounters.exit: They withdraw if the Warden falls or if the party crosses the Cult's circle.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-7 characters. Fewer Sergeants for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: Kessa's guard at the Heart-Hall
encounters.tactics: Only if the party tries to take the Heart by force; the Champions pick duelists and the riders encircle.
encounters.exit: Kessa stops it for a fair wager or a yielded blade.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-8 characters. Drop one Champion for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Sleepless of the Tor
encounters.tactics: They form from the fears of sleepers or newly woken characters and focus them one at a time.
encounters.exit: They dissolve at dawn, if Mirel rings, or in the Cult's circle.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-8 characters. Three for a lighter fight; five for a harder one.

encounters.title: A Court patrol arrives
encounters.tactics: The Wardens hold the road, the knights charge, and the Hushmen flank. They want the Ringer and the Heart.
encounters.exit: They withdraw if three Wardens fall, or if the party surrenders a Heart.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-8 characters. Remove a Warden and the knights for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The column's vanguard
encounters.tactics: The Wardens hold the road, the knights charge, and the Hushmen flank; the party has Surprise if the ambush is good.
encounters.exit: They withdraw if three Wardens fall or the party holds the Key.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-9 characters. Remove a Warden and the knights for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Strike (Haldric still commands)
encounters.tactics: Knights and Wardens hold the line; Hushmen flank on horseback; Maudrin casts Silence on the party's casters and shoots Hush Bolts from behind the line. Haldric duels the strongest fighter. Allies take objectives; do not delete creatures.
encounters.exit: Maudrin retreats toward the Tor when Bloodied. Surrender is offered before and during. The Key in the party's hands breaks the line (Haldric hesitates).
encounters.scale: Written for four level-9 characters. For a lighter fight remove a Warden and a Sergeant; for a harder one add a Warden. A captured Maudrin ends the line.

encounters.title: The Strike (Rook won the duel)
encounters.tactics: Without knights, the Wardens expose their stones around Maudrin and the Hushmen pin casters. Rook's knights hold the ridge.
encounters.exit: Maudrin retreats when Bloodied; her Hushmen surrender if she is captured or the Key is taken.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-9 characters. For a lighter fight remove a Warden and two Sergeants; for a harder one add a Warden.

encounters.title: The Strike (Tristan's column)
encounters.tactics: Tristan hangs back and sends Wardens forward; he surrenders when the Key is taken.
encounters.exit: The column breaks if Tristan yields or the Key is taken.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-9 characters. For a lighter fight remove two Wardens and the knights.

encounters.title: Kessa intercepts
encounters.tactics: Kessa charges the carrier of the Heart; the Champion duels; the riders encircle.
encounters.exit: Kessa yields when Bloodied; he asks only for the Heart back.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-9 characters. Drop three riders for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: Maudrin's last stand at the summit

creatures.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh

encounters.tactics: The Wardens expose their stones to shut down casters near Maudrin; the Hushmen screen the stairway; Maudrin uses Silence on the strongest caster, then Hush Bolts, and walks down the stairs once Bloodied. Legendary actions: Silence Step, Toll of Quiet.
encounters.exit: She retreats when Bloodied; her Hushmen surrender if she orders it, or if the party holds the Key. Allies take objectives.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-10 characters. Remove a Warden for a lighter fight, add one for a harder one.

encounters.title: Maudrin's last stand (with Haldric)

creatures.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh

encounters.tactics: Haldric duels the strongest fighter while the knights hold the stairway; the Wardens' stones shut down casters. He hesitates if he sees the Key in the party's hands.
encounters.exit: Haldric yields to the truth of his parentage (s24-haldric-truth); the Hushmen surrender when Maudrin does.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-10 characters. Drop the knights for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: A three-sided fight at the summit (Corin hostile)

creatures.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh

encounters.tactics: Corin and Maudrin are enemies of each other as well as the party; Corin wants the Key and the hounds go for the case.
encounters.exit: Corin stops if told the cost of the Concord is his own name.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-10 characters. Remove the hounds for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Court remnant at the stones
encounters.tactics: Tristan hangs back; Wardens hold the stairs; knights charge.
encounters.exit: They yield if Tristan yields or the Key is shown.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-10 characters. Remove three Wardens for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: Corin's line at the stones
encounters.tactics: Corin's line and any Ironhorn hold the stones; the hounds go for the Wardens' cases.
encounters.exit: Corin yields on Bloodied.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-10 characters. Remove the Ironhorn for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Court's sealers
encounters.tactics: They block the stairs with Wardens' stones and a wall of knights; they do not pursue past the first landing.
encounters.exit: They yield if Maudrin is captured or the Key is shown.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-11 characters. Remove two Wardens for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Sleepless on the stairs
encounters.tactics: They stand on the steps; they gaze and touch when approached.
encounters.exit: They dissolve at dawn or when the Cult hums.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-11 characters. Five for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Seventh Bell (Haldric present)

creatures.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh

encounters.tactics: Maudrin works toward the recess; Wardens screen her; Haldric duels. She talks before she fights.
encounters.exit: Bargain, grapple, disarm or block her; she yields when the Key leaves her hand. She never retreats from the shrine.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-11 characters. Remove two Wardens for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Seventh Bell (Haldric turned or absent)

creatures.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh

encounters.tactics: As the main scene without Haldric.
encounters.exit: As the main scene.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-11 characters. Remove two Wardens for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Seventh Bell (Corin hostile)

creatures.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh

encounters.tactics: Corin races Maudrin to the bell. Interrupt either.
encounters.exit: Corin stops if told the cost is his own name.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-11 characters. Remove the hounds for a lighter fight.

encounters.title: The Sleepless gather during the sealing minute
encounters.tactics: They form from the fears of whoever holds the seal and surround them.
encounters.exit: They dissolve when the seal completes, or if the Cult hums.
encounters.scale: Written for four level-11 characters. Five for a lighter fight.

statblocks.name: Hushman
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Lawful Neutral*** · **CR 1/2** (XP 100; PB +2) · *2024 base: Tough*

**AC** 12 (leather coat) · **HP** 32 (5d8 + 10) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** +1 (11)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 10 (+0) | 11 (+0) | 10 (+0) |

**Skills** Insight +2, Intimidation +2, Perception +2 · **Senses** Passive Perception 12 · **Languages** Hesk, Common

**Traits**
- ***Pack Tactics.*** The Hushman has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
- ***Silent Hands.*** The creature’s attacks make no sound, and Tonework that senses sound or tone (a Bell-Touched character’s hearing, a Tone-Scholar’s listening) can’t detect them. The gloves suppress only their own strikes, not nearby spellcasting (house rule, 2.6).

**Actions**
- ***Silence-Glove Strike.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Necrotic damage. A target concentrating on a spell has Disadvantage on the saving throw to keep it.
- ***Arrest.*** *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) and can’t cast spells with a Verbal component while grappled this way.
- ***Heavy Crossbow.*** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

**At the table.** Hushmen want an arrest, not a body. They retreat when Bloodied unless a Sergeant is watching. Tobias Quill uses this block.

statblocks.name: Hushman Sergeant
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Lawful Neutral*** · **CR 2** (XP 450; PB +2) · *2024 base: Bandit Captain*

**AC** 15 (Court breastplate) · **HP** 52 (8d8 + 16) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) |

**Saving Throws** Str +4, Wis +3 · **Skills** Athletics +4, Insight +3, Intimidation +4 · **Senses** Passive Perception 11 · **Languages** Hesk, Common

**Traits**
- ***Silent Hands.*** The creature’s attacks make no sound, and Tonework that senses sound or tone (a Bell-Touched character’s hearing, a Tone-Scholar’s listening) can’t detect them. The gloves suppress only their own strikes, not nearby spellcasting (house rule, 2.6).

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The sergeant makes two attacks, using Silence-Glove Strike or Hand Crossbow in any combination. It can replace one attack with Command.
- ***Silence-Glove Strike.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.
- ***Hand Crossbow.*** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
- ***Command.*** One ally within 30 feet that can see the sergeant’s signal can take a Reaction to make one attack, adding 1d4 to the attack roll.

**Reactions**
- ***Parry.*** *Trigger:* The sergeant is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* It adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

statblocks.name: Hushman Warden
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Lawful Neutral*** · **CR 4** (XP 1,100; PB +2) · *2024 base: Tough Boss*

**AC** 16 (half plate) · **HP** 82 (11d8 + 33) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 17 (+3) | 14 (+2) | 16 (+3) | 11 (+0) | 12 (+1) | 12 (+1) |

**Saving Throws** Str +5, Con +5, Wis +3 · **Skills** Athletics +5, Intimidation +3, Perception +3 · **Senses** Passive Perception 13 · **Languages** Hesk, Common

**Traits**
- ***Pack Tactics.*** As the Hushman.
- ***Silent Hands.*** The creature’s attacks make no sound, and Tonework that senses sound or tone (a Bell-Touched character’s hearing, a Tone-Scholar’s listening) can’t detect them. The gloves suppress only their own strikes, not nearby spellcasting (house rule, 2.6).
- ***Warden’s Stone.*** The warden carries a portable silence-stone in a lead case. While the stone is exposed, spells can’t be cast within a 10-foot Emanation originating from the warden, and spells already within it are suppressed (house rule, 2.6). The exposed stone is an object (AC 12, HP 10) that can be targeted, or knocked from its chain with a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as a Utilize action.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The warden makes two attacks, using Silence Maul or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
- ***Silence Maul.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the warden pushes it up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
- ***Heavy Crossbow.*** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

**Bonus Actions**
- ***Expose the Stone (1/Day).*** The warden opens the case. The stone stays exposed for 1 minute or until the warden is Incapacitated or closes the case.

**At the table.** An Acts IV–V elite. Show the case and the dimming light before the warden opens it, so casters can respond.

statblocks.name: Memory-Eel
statblocks.body:
***Large Beast, Unaligned*** · **CR 1/4** (XP 50; PB +2) · *2024 base: Constrictor Snake*

**AC** 13 · **HP** 13 (2d10 + 2) · **Speed** 10 ft., swim 30 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 1 (-5) | 10 (+0) | 3 (-4) |

**Skills** Perception +2, Stealth +4 · **Senses** Blindsight 10 ft., Passive Perception 12 · **Languages** —

**Traits**
- ***Water Breathing.*** The eel can breathe only underwater.

**Actions**
- ***Bite.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the bite deals damage, the target makes a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. *Failure:* The target loses one minor memory, chosen by its player, until it finishes a Long Rest. Record it in the ledger as an Eel loss.
- ***Coil.*** *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 7 (3d4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While it grapples a target, the eel can drag it 10 feet underwater as part of its movement.

**At the table.** The player always chooses the lost memory and keeps full control of the character. Eels ignore people sitting still in boats for the first round.

statblocks.name: Drowned Singer
statblocks.body:
***Medium Undead, Neutral*** · **CR 1** (XP 200; PB +2) · *2024 base: Ghoul*

**AC** 12 · **HP** 22 (5d8) · **Speed** 20 ft., swim 40 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 10 (+0) | 8 (-1) | 12 (+1) | 12 (+1) |

**Immunities** Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned · **Senses** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 11 · **Languages** understands Hesk; sings the names of the dead

**Traits**
- ***Drowned.*** The Singer doesn’t need to breathe.
- ***Response Hymn.*** If a creature within 60 feet sings Mother Sallow’s response hymn as an action, the Singer stops attacking that creature’s group and won’t pursue them for 1 hour, unless one of them attacks it.
- ***Surface Line.*** The Singer never pursues a creature above the water’s surface.

**Actions**
- ***Cold Grasp.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Cold damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12); while grappled underwater, the Singer can pull it 10 feet deeper as part of its movement.
- ***Wail of Names (Recharge 5–6).*** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the Singer that can hear it. *Failure:* 5 (2d4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

**At the table.** v5’s ghoul paralysis is removed: at levels 1–2 underwater it would be lethal. Breath (2024 Suffocation) is the real clock in this fight.

statblocks.name: Ondra Sallow, the Cantor
statblocks.body:
***Medium Undead, Neutral*** · **CR 4** (XP 1,100; PB +2) · *2024 base: Ghost*

**AC** 11 · **HP** 45 (10d8) · **Speed** 5 ft., fly 40 ft. (hover), swim 40 ft. · **Initiative** +1 (11)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 (-2) | 13 (+1) | 10 (+0) | 10 (+0) | 14 (+2) | 17 (+3) |

**Resistances** Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder · **Immunities** Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained · **Senses** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12 · **Languages** Hesk; speaks only in lines of hymns

**Traits**
- ***Incorporeal Movement.*** She can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.
- ***Cantor of the Choir.*** Drowned allies within 60 feet that can hear her have a +2 bonus to saving throws against the Frightened condition.
- ***The Grieving Are Spared.*** She never attacks a creature that has truthfully named someone it grieves to her, unless it attacks her or the bell.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The Cantor makes two Grief-Bolt attacks.
- ***Grief-Bolt.*** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (3d6 + 3) Psychic damage.
- ***Dirge of Names.*** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature that isn’t Undead in a 60-foot Cone that can hear her. *Failure:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of her next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to her Dirge for 24 hours.

**At the table.** She fights only if someone defaces the bell after her warning. Act V, as a released ally at the summit: give her 90 HP and Grief-Bolt 17 (4d6 + 3) (about CR 6).

statblocks.name: Glass-Wolf
statblocks.body:
***Large Beast, Unaligned*** · **CR 1** (XP 200; PB +2) · *2024 base: Dire Wolf*

**AC** 14 (glass hide) · **HP** 22 (3d10 + 6) · **Speed** 50 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 17 (+3) | 15 (+2) | 15 (+2) | 3 (-4) | 12 (+1) | 7 (-2) |

**Skills** Perception +5, Stealth +4 · **Vulnerabilities** Thunder · **Immunities** Cold · **Senses** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15 · **Languages** —

**Traits**
- ***Pack Tactics.*** As the Dire Wolf.
- ***Frozen Stillness.*** While motionless, the wolf is indistinguishable from a glass sculpture.
- ***Shatter.*** When the wolf dies, it bursts. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation. *Failure:* 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.

**Actions**
- ***Bite.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

statblocks.name: Stilled Person
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Any*** · **CR 2** (XP 450; PB +2) · *2024 base: Gargoyle*

**AC** 15 (glass shell) · **HP** 67 (9d8 + 27) · **Speed** 20 ft. · **Initiative** -1 (9)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 (+2) | 8 (-1) | 16 (+3) | 6 (-2) | 11 (+0) | 7 (-2) |

**Immunities** Cold, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Petrified, Poisoned · **Senses** Passive Perception 10 · **Languages** the languages it knew (some speak an old dialect of Common)

**Traits**
- ***Winter-Moment.*** While motionless, the Stilled is indistinguishable from a glass statue. It doesn’t act until its glass is damaged; then it wakes hostile and confused.
- ***Melting Shell.*** When the Stilled takes Fire damage, its AC becomes 10 until the end of its next turn.
- ***Dreamless Glass.*** Magic can’t put the Stilled to sleep.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The Stilled makes two Frozen Claw attacks.
- ***Frozen Claw.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

**At the table.** A woken adult can be calmed instead of fought: a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) or Charisma (Persuasion) Influence check made with an action ends its hostility. A Stilled child never attacks.

statblocks.name: The Glass Sexton (Imber Vesk)
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid (encased), Lawful Neutral*** · **CR 7** (XP 2,900; PB +3) · *2024 base: Gargoyle + Priest*

**AC** 15 (frost-form) or 13 (broken-form) · **HP** 95 frost-form, then 45 broken-form (see Phases) · **Speed** 0 ft. (frost-form) or 30 ft. (broken-form) · **Initiative** +0 (10)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 (+3) | 10 (+0) | 18 (+4) | 16 (+3) | 18 (+4) | 19 (+4) |

**Saving Throws** Con +7, Wis +7, Cha +7 · **Skills** Religion +6, Persuasion +7 · **Resistances** Cold; Piercing and Slashing (frost-form only) · **Immunities** Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Petrified, Poisoned · **Senses** Passive Perception 14 · **Languages** Hesk, in a four-hundred-year-old cadence

**Traits**
- ***Phases.*** The Sexton starts in frost-form. When frost-form drops to 0 HP, it shatters (see Shattering) and broken-form begins with 45 HP; excess damage is lost. When broken-form drops to 0 HP, the combat shell breaks: frail Imber survives unless the party deliberately kills him, and the Frost Heart falls from his crown.
- ***Melting Prison.*** When the Sexton takes Fire or Lightning damage in frost-form, his AC drops by 2 until the end of his next turn (minimum 11). Outside combat, 20 Fire or Lightning damage to the ice, or a DC 15 Strength check, ends the winter-moment peacefully.
- ***Shattering.*** When frost-form ends: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation. *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Slashing damage. *Success:* Half damage.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack (frost-form).*** The Sexton makes two Icicle Volley attacks. He can replace one with Sermon of Stillness.
- ***Icicle Volley.*** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.
- ***Sermon of Stillness.*** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation that can hear him. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn; while Charmed this way its Speed is 0.
- ***Multiattack (broken-form).*** The Sexton makes two Glass Claw attacks, or uses Shattering Voice.
- ***Glass Claw.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Cold damage.
- ***Shattering Voice (Recharge 5–6).*** *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

**Reactions**
- ***Glass Rebuke.*** *Trigger:* A creature within 10 feet hits the Sexton with a melee attack. *Response:* Shards burst; the attacker makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or takes 7 (2d6) Slashing damage.

**At the table.** He fights only if attacked or provoked past a warning. For three level-5 characters, use 70 HP in frost-form. Listening to his confession (S13) gives the Frost Heart without a fight.

statblocks.name: Storm-stone Golem
statblocks.body:
***Large Construct, Unaligned*** · **CR 5** (XP 1,800; PB +3) · *2024 base: Flesh Golem*

**AC** 15 (bronze plates) · **HP** 93 (11d10 + 33) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** -1 (9)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 19 (+4) | 9 (-1) | 17 (+3) | 6 (-2) | 10 (+0) | 5 (-3) |

**Immunities** Lightning, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned · **Senses** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10 · **Languages** understands the commands of whoever holds its storm-stone shard

**Traits**
- ***Lightning Absorption.*** Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains HP equal to the Lightning damage dealt.
- ***Magic Resistance.*** The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- ***Storm-Stone Core.*** Once per round, when the golem is hit by a melee attack made with a metal weapon, it discharges. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation. *Failure:* 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The golem makes two Slam attacks, or uses Lightning Arc.
- ***Slam.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.
- ***Lightning Arc (Recharge 5–6).*** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

**At the table.** Prising out its storm-stone shard (Utilize action, DC 15 Strength (Athletics) while adjacent, possible once it is Bloodied) deactivates it. Wooden weapons don’t trigger its Heart.

statblocks.name: Sleepless
statblocks.body:
***Medium Aberration (Shapechanger), Chaotic Neutral*** · **CR 5** (XP 1,800; PB +3) · *2024 base: Wraith*

**AC** 13 · **HP** 67 (9d8 + 27) · **Speed** 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover) · **Initiative** +3 (13)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 (+0) | 16 (+3) | 16 (+3) | 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 15 (+2) |

**Resistances** Bludgeoning, Piercing, Psychic, Slashing · **Immunities** Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone, Unconscious · **Senses** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12 · **Languages** speaks in the voices of the sleeper’s memories

**Traits**
- ***Shape of Fear.*** When it forms, the Sleepless takes the shape of the greatest fear of the nearest sleeping or newly woken creature. That creature has Disadvantage on saving throws against its Terrifying Gaze.
- ***Dream-Stuff.*** The Sleepless can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
- ***Mirel’s Lullaby.*** If Mirel rings within a mile, every Sleepless dissolves into mist.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The Sleepless uses Terrifying Gaze and makes one Nightmare Touch attack.
- ***Nightmare Touch.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (3d8 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken until it finishes a Long Rest.
- ***Terrifying Gaze.*** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet that can see it. *Failure:* 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

statblocks.name: Heart-Hound
statblocks.body:
***Medium Construct, Unaligned*** · **CR 3** (XP 700; PB +2) · *2024 base: Hell Hound*

**AC** 15 (cast bronze) · **HP** 58 (9d8 + 18) · **Speed** 50 ft. · **Initiative** +1 (11)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 17 (+3) | 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 6 (-2) | 13 (+1) | 6 (-2) |

**Skills** Perception +5 · **Immunities** Poison, Thunder; Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned · **Senses** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15 · **Languages** understands Hesk but can’t speak

**Traits**
- ***Pack Tactics.*** As the Hell Hound.
- ***Hushman’s Bane.*** The hound has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to find a creature carrying silence-stone.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The hound makes two Bite attacks.
- ***Bite.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Thunder damage. On a hit it rings: its enemies within 30 feet have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the end of their next turn.
- ***Peal (Recharge 5–6).*** *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (5d6) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

statblocks.name: Ironhorn Rider
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Chaotic Good*** · **CR 3** (XP 700; PB +2) · *2024 base: Warrior Veteran*

**AC** 18 (bronze scale, shield) · **HP** 65 (10d8 + 20) · **Speed** 30 ft. (mounted: the horse’s Speed) · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 (+3) | 14 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 10 (+0) | 12 (+1) | 10 (+0) |

**Skills** Animal Handling +3, Athletics +5, Perception +3 · **Senses** Passive Perception 13 · **Languages** Hesk, Ironhorn cant

**Traits**
- ***Born in the Saddle.*** The rider has Advantage on saving throws to avoid falling off its mount, and its mount uses the rider’s Initiative.
- ***Charge.*** If the rider moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target while mounted and then hits it with a Lance, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The rider makes two attacks, using Lance or Longbow in any combination.
- ***Lance.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.
- ***Longbow.*** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

**Reactions**
- ***Parry.*** *Trigger:* The rider is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* It adds 2 to its AC against that attack.

**At the table.** Mounts count separately in encounter XP: a Warhorse is CR 1/2. Yenna Garrow uses this block.

statblocks.name: Ironhorn Champion
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Chaotic Neutral*** · **CR 5** (XP 1,800; PB +3) · *2024 base: Gladiator*

**AC** 16 (bronze scale) · **HP** 112 (15d8 + 45) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 (+4) | 15 (+2) | 16 (+3) | 10 (+0) | 12 (+1) | 15 (+2) |

- ***Wager-Proud.*** The champion has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition while anyone it has made a wager with can see it.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** The champion makes three Bronze Greataxe attacks. It can replace one with Horn Shove.
- ***Bronze Greataxe.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage.
- ***Horn Shove.*** *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and a Medium or smaller target has the Prone condition.

**Reactions**

statblocks.name: Thane Oru Kessa
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Chaotic Good*** · **CR 7** (XP 2,900; PB +3) · *2024 base: Gladiator*

**AC** 17 (bronze-wire scale, shield) · **HP** 136 (16d8 + 64) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 (+5) | 14 (+2) | 18 (+4) | 11 (+0) | 13 (+1) | 16 (+3) |

**Saving Throws** Str +8, Con +7, Wis +4 · **Skills** Athletics +11, Intimidation +6, Persuasion +6 · **Senses** Passive Perception 11 · **Languages** Hesk, Ironhorn cant

**Traits**
- ***Lightning-Sick.*** When Kessa scores a Critical Hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Lightning damage from Thrane’s Heart, and so does Kessa.
- ***Last Fury.*** While Bloodied, Kessa has Advantage on attack rolls.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** Kessa makes three Bronze Greataxe attacks.
- ***Bronze Greataxe.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (1d12 + 5) Slashing damage.

**Bonus Actions**
- ***Thrane’s Heart (Recharge 5–6).*** *Requires Thrane’s Heart in hand or on his belt.* *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage. Kessa takes 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.

**At the table.** Kessa offers trade, then challenge, then alliance. If he fights the party, it is because they lied to him.

**Traits**
- ***Warden of Silence.*** While Maudrin carries the Tuning Key, she has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.
- ***The Strike Takes Her Hand.*** Striking Ysh requires her action while adjacent to the bell with the Key out of its case. Grappling, disarming, bargaining or blocking her route can prevent it (v5, Session 26).

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** Maudrin makes three Hush Bolt attacks, or casts a spell and makes one Hush Bolt attack.

**Bonus Actions**
- ***Warden’s Retreat.*** While Bloodied, Maudrin takes the Disengage action, and her Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the turn.

**Reactions**
- ***Protective Magic (2/Day).*** Maudrin casts Counterspell or Shield in response to its trigger.
- ***Silence-Stone Gloves.*** *Trigger:* A creature within 10 feet makes a spell attack roll. *Response:* The attack has Disadvantage (v5 ruling).

**At the table.** She offers a bargain before a threat. At the Strike she retreats when Bloodied; at the summit she prefers to seal Ysh and keep control. Carry her actual HP between scenes. If she reaches the Hush Shrine with the Key, use Maudrin, Keeper of the Seventh instead.

statblocks.name: Maudrin Vesk, Keeper of the Seventh
statblocks.body:
***Medium Humanoid, Lawful Neutral*** · **CR 12** (XP 8,400; PB +4) · *2024 base: Archmage*

**AC** 17 (warded silk, plus 2 from the Key’s hum while she holds it) · **HP** 170 (31d8 + 31) · **Speed** 30 ft. · **Initiative** +2 (12)

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 (-1) | 14 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 20 (+5) | 16 (+3) | 17 (+3) |

**Saving Throws** Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +7 · **Skills** Deception +7, History +9, Insight +7, Persuasion +11 · **Immunities** Psychic; Charmed, Frightened (while she holds the Key) · **Senses** Passive Perception 13 · **Languages** Hesk, Common, and the bell-script of the Tower

**Traits**
- ***Legendary Resistance (3/Day).*** If Maudrin fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.
- ***Magic Resistance.*** Maudrin has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- ***The Strike Takes Her Hand.*** Striking or sealing Ysh takes her action while adjacent to the bell with the Key out of its case. Grappling her, knocking the Key from her hand (DC 17 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) as a Utilize action), bargaining or blocking her route can prevent it.

**Actions**
- ***Multiattack.*** Maudrin makes four Hush Bolt attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.
- ***Hush Bolt.*** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. *Hit:* 23 (4d8 + 5) Psychic damage: the sound of nothing.
- ***Spellcasting.*** Maudrin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence (spell save DC 17), requiring no Verbal components: At will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Message, Minor Illusion. 2/Day each: Hold Person, Silence. 1/Day each: Dimension Door, Modify Memory, Wall of Force.

**Reactions**
- ***Protective Magic (3/Day).*** Maudrin casts Counterspell or Shield in response to its trigger.
- ***Silence-Stone Gloves.*** *Trigger:* A creature within 10 feet makes a spell attack roll. *Response:* The attack has Disadvantage (v5 ruling).

**Legendary Actions**
*Legendary Action Uses: 3.* Immediately after another creature’s turn, Maudrin can expend a use to take one of the following actions. Maudrin regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
- ***Hush Bolt.*** Maudrin makes one Hush Bolt attack.
- ***Silence Step.*** Maudrin teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see inside the shrine.
- ***Toll of Quiet.*** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature of Maudrin’s choice in a 20-foot Emanation originating from her. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only. Maudrin can’t take this action again until the start of her next turn.

**At the table.** Use this block when Maudrin holds the Tuning Key at the summit (S24) or the Hush Shrine (S26). She talks before she fights and will parley in place of any attack. Her goal is the bell, not the party: track her route to Ysh each round. Bloodied and alone, she offers terms for the Court’s survival. She never retreats from the shrine.

briefs.pressure: The Coster ship Gilded Heron docks this morning and the Quays are loud with cargo. Tobias Quill's memory quota is short because Pellmoor pays its way in gold now; he reaches the Old Shore on the second evening with one guard (the first evening if Venn tips him off). Ila has not slept properly in six weeks. Strangers' Row, the Loud Quarter, is a short walk from the Quays: the Dawn Mission, the Brass Lantern and a forger's back room are all there. If the party does nothing, Quill finds the Heart by the third day.
briefs.endOn: Who was singing?
briefs.npcs: Ila Harrow, Mother Sallow, Hushman Tobias Quill, Dorra Pell, Pilot-Mistress Brannagh Wick, Reckoner Sela Maunt, Master Orsolo Venn, Sister Aurelie Dawnmantle, a Harper with a lute
checklist: Decide how each character arrives: by ship through the Seam, by the Mere road, or already living in Pellmoor. Ask each player whether the character grew up under the Court (it matters at S5)
Have the Reckoning House slate ready: 1 keep = 1 gp 2 sp, motes 1 sp, heartkeeps by appraisal
Know Quill's one question: 'Where did the child's coat go?'
Prepare Mother Sallow's response hymn as a two-line call and answer you can sing or speak
Ask each player for one thing their character has lost; note it for the Toll and memory ledger
Written for four level-3 characters, who have subclasses and 2nd-level spells: have the any-l3 rulings plays open (Hold Person, Suggestion, Detect Thoughts, Locate Object, Misty Step)
Strangers' Row is where Aurelie, the Harpers and a forger are introduced: set aurelie, stormborn and writ from those plays

briefs.pressure: The Night Song rises at dusk and the Old Shore hums back. The eastern-marsh ferry has been missing a week. Brother Hadrik Voss, a Kelemvorite from Strangers' Row, plans to 'lay the dead to rest' on the Memory Shore tonight. Quill writes his report to Hallowmere.
briefs.endOn: Who was on the ferry?
briefs.npcs: Mother Sallow, the Cantor (Ondra Sallow), the Tidewarden, Pilot-Mistress Brannagh Wick, Brother Hadrik Voss, Ila Harrow
checklist: Mere Memory table (v5 Part 11.4) at hand; decide whether one failed save becomes Tam's last night (a clue)
2024 Suffocation and Frigid Water if anyone dives; the belfry top is about 40 feet down
Eel thefts: the player picks the lost minor memory; it returns after a long rest
Decide how the Cantor reacts to a true answer, and whether she teaches the release verse (only for a sincere memory of a dead person)
Check ila: if the raid took her, the Mere road cart is the rescue (s02-intercept-ila-cart)
S1 to S5 are level 3; the party reaches level 4 after the Hallowmere investigation (S6). Do not hand out levels in the Mere

briefs.pressure: Brother Eld knows the page is missing and is frightened. Quill's report has reached Hallowmere. Master Venn sends a polite note offering to buy 'a humming relic'. The Chancellor's letter arrives at the end of the session whatever the party does.
briefs.endOn: What will you carry to Hallowmere?
briefs.npcs: Mother Sallow, Brother Eld, Ila Harrow, Master Orsolo Venn, Pilot-Mistress Brannagh Wick, the Cantor, the Tidewarden
checklist: Eld's papers: the missing page, the matching Court forms, and the patrol entry recording Tam's interrogation
Read the Ossa Toll aloud before any ringing: 'A memory of someone who has died. You choose it. If you say no, the bell does not ring.' Ila may not be the Ringer
Venn's offer: 600 gp now; the Gilded Heron sails in three days (s03-heron-sails runs that clock out)
Write the Chancellor's letter as a prop; it doubles as a writ of passage
Check ila: free, hidden, travelling or arrested decides which of the Ila plays show tonight
The party is still level 3 here; level 4 comes after S6

briefs.pressure: The Quiet Assembly falls ten days after the letter, and Maudrin has read Quill's report. Every visitor registers at the Gate Office and gives a courtesy memory; Hushmen check those records. Isolde has been asked to learn what the party cares about. Each night the party sleeps in Hallowmere ticks the Tithe Clock. If the party stayed to defend Pellmoor, the siege takes three days, the road to the capital takes three more, and the Assembly still has a day to spare.
briefs.endOn: Who in this city can you trust?
briefs.npcs: Chancellor Maudrin Vesk, Lady Isolde Drave, Ser Haldric Mose, Clerk Oswin Tell, Sergeant Mabry Cole, Brother Eld, Captain Dessa Rook, Sister Aurelie Dawnmantle
checklist: Check Ossa's Heart: party, Ila, Belfry, armory, Court or Venn/abroad decides which bargain Maudrin offers
Check ila (free, hidden, travelling, arrested) and quill (Suspicious or Tithe-case: Gate DCs +2; Bribed: DCs -2; Dead: Cole names the killers)
Check Brother Eld: fled or forgiven puts him at the masque; gone or dead means an unnamed Court chaplain
Check each Stormborn character's writ (invited, true, forged, none) and whether Aurelie was met on Strangers' Row
Seed two secrets lightly: Maudrin calls Haldric 'dear' once and corrects herself to 'Ser'; Isolde wears a locket with a boy's portrait and closes it when asked
Give the Blank clerk and Sergeant Cole voices; the clerk will not take gold
Prepare Maudrin's three lines: the welcome, the bargain, and 'Then the Assembly will go on without you'
Written for four level-3 characters: Comprehend Languages is the only translation magic they have; Hearts, Dispel Magic and Counterspell are NPC-only until level 5

briefs.pressure: Lysse has been asking about Edda Thorne too loudly, and the Archive's keepers have noticed. Ansel tallies the vault every morning. If Calla's Heart or the Ledger leaves, four Hushmen search every cart for two days. Wren Caddock is watching the party for the Court, and for her own reasons.
briefs.endOn: What did the Court take from the diary? (If they never found it: what is the Court keeping in that vault?)
briefs.npcs: Lysse Carrow, the Librarian of the Sealed Book, Ansel Quay, Wren Caddock, the vault's Hushmen
checklist: Write the jar labels you will read aloud: each character's earliest-memory jar only if they grew up under the Court (otherwise the S4 courtesy jar), OSTROW B. 340 SS, BRAY M. 408 SS, SALLOW M. (wedding day)
Prepare Edda's Quiet Night entry as a handout
Mark the silence-stone field on the vault map: it covers the door and the whole room
Decide whether to use the EXPORT — VENNMARK column (optional v6 reveal)
Note the alarm: Hushmen in three rounds; cart searches for two days if Calla's Heart or the Ledger leaves
Write Haldric's payment line for S6: 'for H.V., at the Chancellor's pleasure: three heartkeeps, quarterly' (H.V. is Haldric Vesk; do not explain it)
Add Isolde's entry to the Ledger: 'DRAVE, I.: twelve heartkeeps, I.C., 411 SS' (the Ironhorn Compact)

briefs.pressure: The oath-hearing is in two days on the Dawn Steps, and the Court has bet heavily on Haldric. Haldric knows the party is looking. Wren has decided to confess before the Court notices Ansel's copies. If nobody acts, Rook's case fails and Court patrols tighten.
briefs.endOn: What will the defeated side do next?
briefs.npcs: Captain Dessa Rook, Ser Haldric Mose, Wren Caddock, Tessa Caddock, Bet Ostrow, Ansel Quay, Ilam Bray, Brother Eld
checklist: Check what evidence the party holds: the Ledger, Ansel's copy, Eld's note, their own sight of Haldric at the masque
Write Haldric's payment entry as a handout: 'for H.V., at the Chancellor's pleasure: three heartkeeps, quarterly'
Run the duel exactly: one oath each, three questions each, refusing to answer loses
Confirm session-zero Off-limits for child peril; if needed, Tessa is Wren's adult sister
Know where Ila is: if arrested, she is in the same dormitory as Tessa (s06-rescue-tessa-with-ila)
Rook plants the Haldric seed: he came to the Order at twelve with a palace letter and no family name but Mose
Record the duel result for S9 and S23. The party reaches level 4 after this session

briefs.pressure: Hushmen will sweep the Hall of Tithes steps at dusk. Ilam Bray is on the line. If nobody takes a side, the Blanks are arrested and Jonah is taken into custody. The Court watches which faces stand with the crowd.
briefs.endOn: Where can this family be safe?
briefs.npcs: Jonah Bray, Ilam Bray, Mara Bray, Sergeant Orla Gaunt, the Blanks, Bet Ostrow, Captain Dessa Rook
checklist: Give Jonah's wooden bird one detail: a notch where the knife slipped
Check Off-limits for child peril; Jonah can be an older Blank youth if needed, and is never harmed on-screen
Know whether the party holds jars or the Ledger from S5: they make promises real
Prepare Ilam's Hushman roster as a handout in case he deserts
Decide where the family sleeps tonight: Bet's attic, the barracks, or nowhere safe
The default Hushmen Line is two Sergeants and eight Hushmen for four level-4 characters; use Gaunt and six if the table is happy to play it lighter

briefs.pressure: Isolde has orders to follow the party if they leave the city. Court agents want the letter and its courier. The Sexton's sermon is spreading along the North Road. Each night they stay, the Tithe Clock ticks.
briefs.endOn: What does I.V. want from you?
briefs.npcs: Edrin Moss, Lady Isolde Drave, Chancellor Maudrin Vesk (by message), Wyn Talla (by report), Lysse Carrow
checklist: Make the letter a prop: blue wax, one sentence, signed I.V.
Read Maudrin's last word through Isolde exactly as written
Check the Tithe Clock: at 6 the Court sweeps the city and checkpoints every road
Decide what Isolde already knows of the party from S4, and whether the Ironhorn entry (S5) or her son's locket (S4) is in play
Wyn Talla is Maren's descendant: the Tallas have kept watch on the glass for four hundred years and call the woman in it 'the sister'
Written for four level-4 characters: Detect Thoughts, Suggestion and Hold Person are all in play for the courier scene; rule them from any-l3-truth-and-minds

briefs.pressure: If Calla's Heart or the Ledger left the vault, four Hushmen search every cart for two days. Isolde has orders to follow the party north. If Vaer rings, the Court issues a Silence Warrant at once; Aurelie, if she is in the city, goes to the terraces to sing. The Tithe Clock is wherever the city stay left it. Jonah, Mara's jar, Rook's loan of Vaer's Heart and a last visit to the vault are all still open, so S9 is the session where loose threads get tied.
briefs.endOn: Which unfinished promise will you carry north?
briefs.npcs: Lady Isolde Drave, Captain Dessa Rook, Bet Ostrow, Wren Caddock, Sister Aurelie Dawnmantle, Nessa Harrow, Sergeant Mabry Cole
checklist: Run the seven Hallowmere Ledger questions and set flags as they are answered
Check which Hearts the party holds: Vaer's, Calla's, Mirel's, Ossa's, and where Ossa's is (armory, Court, Venn, abroad)
Read both Tolls before any ringing: Vaer, a memory of a dawn you loved; Calla, a Gift
Know the chain-room: silence-stone chains on Vaer, Rook's chain-key, two knights
Check jonah, ilam, aurelie, ila and duel: each decides which loose-thread plays show
Mark days on the road: Vaer's dawn lasts one day, Calla's harvest one season
Level the party to 5 when they leave Hallowmere. Water Breathing and Hearts are still out of reach for this level

briefs.pressure: Isolde is days behind on the North Road. At dusk the Sexton's sermon can be heard at the forest's edge. Glassreach is Extreme Cold from the first hour. Wyn Talla waits at Yara's camp: the Tallas have kept watch over the woman in the glass for four hundred years, and the thaw song is the family's last inheritance.
briefs.endOn: What is the glass hiding?
briefs.npcs: Yara Thenn, Wyn Talla, the Stilled child, Bosun Corran Vell, Edrin Moss
checklist: Note who has a warm cloak or Cold Resistance: they succeed on Extreme Cold saves automatically
Yara's prices: warm cloak 10 gp or a keep, glass-cutting tools 5 gp, the map by friendship only
Decide the Stilled child's age if child peril is a concern: if it is Off-limits, she is an old woman who was a child when the winter came
Place the Faerûnian Stilled (Bosun Corran Vell of the Brightwater) near the clearing
The party is level 5 here: Fireball, Speak with Dead, Hearts and Water Breathing arrive. Rule them before they cast
Every Stilled has been frozen since 2 SS, four hundred and ten years. Only the Sexton's winter-moment is 32 SS, three hundred and eighty

briefs.pressure: Winter-moments near the Sexton's chapel are cracking on their own. The Glass-Wolf pack that guards the Spire hunts this clearing. Isolde is a day or two behind.
briefs.endOn: What did you see in the glass?
briefs.npcs: Maren Talla, Wyn Talla, Yara Thenn, the Stilled, Bosun Corran Vell
checklist: Choose who sees the winter-moment, and write down what the player says their character feels
Stilled wake one or two a round as glass cracks: mark where each one stands
Keep Extreme Cold saves running for anyone without a cloak
Have Maren Talla's one line about the Sexton ready, and remember she was frozen in 2 SS: she is four hundred and ten years out of her time

references.title: Memory money: rates and table rules
references.body:
Corvane traded memories long before the ships came. The Court's Tithe made it a habit and the Reckoners made it a currency. Gold arrived thirty years ago and is winning, slowly.

**How it works**
1. **Drawing.** A memory can be drawn out of a person only with their consent, by a Court-licensed **Reckoner** with a tuning fork and a small stoppered vial of Mere-glass. It takes about a minute and feels like forgetting a word on the tip of your tongue, then not minding. Drawing without a licence is *leeching*, a crime.
2. **Keeps.** A drawn, sealed memory is a **keep**: a vial of faintly luminous mist that hums one low note when held. Reckoners grade it by **weight** (how much feeling it holds) and stamp the wax. The content stays private unless someone opens it.
3. **Keeps circulate sealed,** passed hand to hand like banknotes. Their value rests on two facts: someone will always pay to witness one, and its owner can always redeem it.
4. **Opening.** If the original owner opens a keep, the memory returns whole. Anyone else *witnesses* it, as a guest in someone else's day, without acquiring the owner's identity. Each stranger's witnessing fades it; after three it is a grey, spent vial.
5. **What cannot be drawn:** skills, spells, languages, proficiencies, anything a character can do. "You can sell the day you learned to swim, but never the swimming." Nobody can sell someone else's memory.
6. **Blanks** are people who sold or Tithed so many heavy memories that they no longer recognise their own families.

| Weight | What it holds | Worth at Pellmoor | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mote** | A passing memory: last Ossday's supper, a stranger's coat | about 1 sp | Grey wax. Small change. |
| **Keep** | A memory with feeling: a good afternoon, a small win | about 1 gp (floats daily) | Plain wax. The everyday coin. |
| **Heartkeep** | A defining memory: a parent's face, a wedding day | 25 to 100 gp or more | Red wax. The Tithe prefers them. |
| **Knowing** | Knowledge: a route, a recipe, a password, a face | by usefulness | Blue wax. The seller loses the knowledge. |

**Gold, and why the Court hates it.** Old Corvanese coin was iron "ticks" and Court scrip; bronze is bell-metal. Gold cannot be Tithed, cannot fade, cannot be Reckoned. At Pellmoor nearly every stall takes either. **Court taxes on Corvanese subjects must be paid in memory; foreigners pay the landing due in gold.** Paying a local's Tithe in gold is **gilding**: illegal and common. A keep fetches about 1 gp 2 sp at Pellmoor and about 8 sp in Hallowmere. The Hallowmere gate's courtesy memory is a registration, not a fee, and the clerk refuses gold.

**Table rules (2024)**
- A character may pay in memory wherever coin is accepted in Corvane. The player chooses the memory and writes one line in the Memory ledger (Foresight → Party & ledger). The DM never chooses it.
- A Reckoner buys memories at the posted rate less a 10 percent fee.
- Motes and keeps have no mechanical effect. When a character sells a heartkeep, the player rewrites one thing the memory held up (a belief, a bond, a fear). It never removes player knowledge or control of the character.
- The DM may award **Heroic Inspiration** when a character gives a memory freely to someone who needs it.
- Once, a character who witnesses a Knowing keep has Advantage on one ability check that knowledge plainly helps.
- Keep the kinds apart: a **Toll** can never be bought back; a **Tithe** can be redeemed from its jar; a **trade** is a keep; **Mere Memories** are borrowed; **eel bites** return after a long rest; **stairs** losses follow the stairs' rule.

replace: A **Line** is something we never include. A **Veil** is something we can include, but we skip past it without describing it.
An **Off-limits** topic is something we never include. An **Off-screen** topic is something we can include, but we skip past it without describing it.
